notes: No star is eligible. SB 796 (Gaia DR2 4958223672295639040) is described as a high-velocity RRc, but the paper does not identify it as Galactically unbound; its computed Galactic orbit oscillates between about 0.5 and 20 kpc and passes near the Galactic center repeatedly (T:p1-b9, T:p13-b4), and it was discovered serendipitously rather than followed up as a prior unbound candidate (T:p2-b3).
